criteria.name: novelty
criteria.description: Does this chapter introduce genuinely new value rather than repeating prior chapters?

criteria.name: clarity
criteria.description: Is the argument understandable on first read without re-reading?

criteria.name: structure
criteria.description: Does the chapter move logically and purposefully from point to point?

criteria.name: reader_value
criteria.description: Does the reader gain practical or meaningful conceptual value?

criteria.name: redundancy_risk
criteria.description: How much does the chapter overlap with previous content? (Lower is better — invert for scoring: 10 = no redundancy, 1 = high redundancy)

criteria.name: tone_consistency
criteria.description: Does the chapter match the established voice bible throughout?

criteria.name: evidence_discipline
criteria.description: Are factual or research-sensitive claims handled responsibly without overextension?
